_doc: Freeze enforcement manifest (PE-FREEZE-001). The semantic foundation is frozen at `pin` (ARCHITECTURE-FREEZE.md §2, tag freeze-candidate-1). Any diff since the pin inside `frozen_paths` must be covered by a `change_records` entry below; anything else fails `tools/check_freeze.py` / `make freeze-guard`. CORE-class changes additionally require a docs/ARCHITECTURE-CHANGE-PROPOSAL-*.md per ARCHITECTURE-FREEZE.md §5.

change_records.layer: Bundle-layer transitive proof-linkage resolution (proof_verify::resolve) behind the ArtifactStore seam; record-only, never alters verdicts
Comment wording only (non-English stray text -> English); zero behavior change

P4 remainder: ancestors/descendants traversal + V2 policy leaves (requires_reference/forbids_reference) behind the policy_version capability row; v1 byte-stable (v1_rejects_v2_leaf_names_and_stays_frozen)
Scale: batch verification library + batch-verify CLI (independent members, fail-closed; new module only, no frozen behavior touched)
conformance hardening: implementation brought under frozen fail-closed invariants (see docs/ARCHITECTURE-CHANGE-PROPOSAL-conformance-hardening.md §3, decision PENDING §11)
test-only: unit tests for ArtifactEnvelope (kinds, cbor_bytes bounds) appended to crates/proof-format/src/envelope.rs; zero behavior change, no wire/semantic impact

Independent external review hardening (additive only; verdicts unchanged): helper predicate fns (policy_uses_proof_fresh / policy_uses_not_expired) in crates/proof-policy/src/lib.rs so front ends can warn when advisory freshness stands alone without a signed window. No wire bytes, policy semantics, or verdicts change; frozen v1/v2 evaluation untouched.

created_at binding wire fix (proposal docs/ARCHITECTURE-CHANGE-PROPOSAL-created_at-binding.md): proof_id gains created_at; envelope/id/builder/tests/vectors/interop updated in lockstep. Pre-V1.0 breaking wire change; goldens regenerated.

STATUS feed-hygiene stage (proposal docs/ARCHITECTURE-CHANGE-PROPOSAL-status-hygiene.md): input-hygiene failures leave REVOCATION for STATUS and no longer flip evidence_validity; status_inputs_valid carries feed health. Verdict change by design, pre-V1.0.
